description: Find skills for the job on SkillPicker (https://skillpicker.xyz). Use when the user says "find skills", "find a skill for the job", "find skills by work", "which skill should I install", "有没有 skill", "推荐一个技能", or names a task, role, tool, or agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex) and wants a skill. Do not use it to write a new skill or to decide whether a skill is safe.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
